description:
The Angry Little Dragon: How Deep Breaths Cool the Fire! — Steam shot out of Sparky's ears when his block tower fell! Why did screaming make it worse, and what put out the flame?
Kids science answer for "calming down anger management kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

When big feelings boil like hot lava inside, taking three slow deep breaths sends oxygen to your brain, cooling the fire so you can speak peacefully.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!

- calming down from anger
- emotional regulation for anger
